title: Doesn’t work after a couple weeks!
text: Doesn’t work after a couple weeks!. Works good when it operates.  Two weeks old and it broke down- another cheap product made in China.  Don’t waste your money!

product_metadata.title: Bonsenkitchen Milk Frother Handheld, Automatic Hand Frother Milk Foam Maker for Bulletproof Coffee, Matcha, Hot Chocolate Stainless Steel Whisk Battery Operated Mini Drink Mixer-Silver
features: Perfect Milk Frothing: High speed rotation of food safe stainless-steel whisk and BPA free shaft, this handheld milk frother is perfect for creating rich, creamy froth within 15-20s for bulletproof coffee, latte, milk shake, hot chocolates and matcha powder as well as a good egg beater.

Ergonomic & Portable Design: Lightweight hand frother with an ergonomic handle makes frothing and creating delicate foam easily. Portable size is convenient to carry makes sure you can enjoy your morning coffee although in traveling.
Classic Never Outdate Style: The coffee frother is styled in multi colors perfectly fit with any modern kitchen. Decent present for daily coffee drinkers.

Easy to Use: Simple one-touch switch with a powerful motor but low noise level. Just put it into a container with liquid food up to approx 1/3 to froth. Please keep the temperature of the milk below 60 degree for perfect foam. Battery operated, 2 AA batteries NOT included.
Stainless steel shaft with food safe material is easy to be cleaned in mild soapy water with the whisk moving or just put it into fresh running water.
